# Diction Gateway -- Machine Index

This file is a short index for LLM agents and automated tools.

Full API reference: AGENTS.md (project root)

## Quick facts

- Gateway language: Go
- Routes: GET /health, GET /v1/models, POST /v1/trial, POST /v1/audio/transcriptions, WS /v1/audio/stream, POST /v1/text/process, POST /v1/text/suggest
- Wire format: JSON (no E2E on text routes)
- Auth: off by default (AUTH_ENABLED=false); when on, accepts Apple JWS or HMAC trial tokens
- LLM: optional BYO LLM via LLM_BASE_URL + LLM_MODEL; text routes require TEXT_ROUTES_OPEN=true

## Key env vars

LLM_BASE_URL, LLM_MODEL, LLM_API_KEY, LLM_PROMPT, LLM_PROMPT_EDIT,
LLM_PROMPT_EDIT_SELECTED, LLM_PROMPT_SUGGEST, TEXT_ROUTES_OPEN,
AUTH_ENABLED, DEFAULT_MODEL, GATEWAY_PORT

See AGENTS.md for the full reference.
